subject: Thanks for joining our webinar — can we schedule a quick demo?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Park <samantha@innovatech.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Thanks for joining our webinar — can we schedule a quick demo?

Hi Samantha,

Thanks for registering for yesterday's Redwood webinar on cost-aware inference — really glad you could make it. We had a lot of great questions about routing and cost controls that sounded relevant to what you mentioned on the registration form (scaling inference for a mixed workload).

If you're open to it, I'd love to set up a 30-minute demo next week to show:
- A short walkthrough of the Console (routing/policies/usage dashboards)
- How Dedicated capacity can reduce per-token costs for predictable traffic
- A quick Q&A on security/compliance (SOC2 + audit logs)

I've attached the webinar slides for reference and included a short demo agenda. If it helps, here's my calendar with a few 30-min slots next week: https://calendly.com/redwood-marissa/30min

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 12/1 10:00–10:30am
- Tue 12/1 2:00–2:30pm
- Wed 12/2 11:00–11:30am

If those don't work, tell me a couple times that do and I can coordinate. I'm happy to invite one of our solutions engineers (Aditya) for a deeper technical dive if you want.

Best,
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Redwood-Webinar-Generative-Inference-Slides.pdf
Attachment: demo-agenda.md

From: Samantha Park <samantha@innovatech.com>

Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@innovatech.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Thanks for joining our webinar — can we schedule a quick demo?

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — the webinar was useful. We'd like a 30-min demo next week to see the Console and discuss dedicated vs hosted options. We are on EST (UTC-5) and prefer afternoons our side. Tom (cc'd) is the engineering lead and should join.

Would any of these work on your end (EST)?
- Tue 12/1 1:00–1:30pm EST
- Tue 12/1 4:00–4:30pm EST
- Wed 12/2 12:30–1:00pm EST

If you can pick one, we'll lock it in. Also curious whether you can share any cost comparison for a 2-node dedicated pool vs hosted for ~2M tokens/day.

Thanks,
Samantha Park
Product Manager, Innovatech
Samantha@innovatech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Hi Samantha — great, thanks for the options. Those translate to the following PT times:
- Tue 12/1 10:00–10:30am PT (1:00pm EST)
- Tue 12/1 1:00–1:30pm PT (4:00pm EST)
- Wed 12/2 9:30–10:00am PT (12:30pm EST)

I can do Tue 12/1 10:00am PT (1:00pm EST). I've tentatively blocked that slot and put Aditya on the invite since you mentioned an engineering lead — he can answer the dedicated-capacity pricing/throughput questions.

Quick note on the cost question: I'll follow up after the call with a short cost comparison doc for a 2-node dedicated pool vs hosted for ~2M tokens/day (ballpark numbers + assumptions). If you want that ahead of the meeting, let me know and I'll push it to you.

I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm — or feel free to pick the Calendly link (https://calendly.com/redwood-marissa/30min) and it will auto-add the right folks.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa
